newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa likely to consolidate, could edge up.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa likely to consolidate, could edge up.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa futures should hold above a small upward channel while the benchmark July contract consolidates gains above the psychological 1,000 stg mark, technical analysts said on Monday.
Sentiment in London turned more optimistic on Friday as July closed above 1,036 stg, although the performance in New York dampened some of the earlier enthusiasm.
Traders called the market to open as much as 10 stg lower than Friday's close, after long liquidation by speculators drove New York to close sharply down.
But one trader said London could be headed higher, calling the market to open four stg down.
Technical analysts noted a small upward channel extending from the 981 stg low dating from early May, saying this was likely to act as solid nearby support.
"Cocoa remains confined by the upchannel..but it doesn't look particularly bearish or bullish," said Adrian Haylor, a technical analyst at Sucden.

"I think the upchannel is a fairly good description of trade in London," he said, placing initial support at 1,016 stg. There is a also a small chart gap between 1,033 and 1,034, just below Friday's session low.
On the upside, traders have said they expect July's main target at 1,065 stg, the April 2 high. If this point was broken, then a move higher to 1,100 and possibly 1,200 could be seen, they said.
